actor: Apple silicon and on-device AI platform lead
job: Bringing the next M-series Mac and an on-device Siri/Foundation-Models assistant to ship-ready state as the default, locally-run experience
outcome: A shipping or beta M-series Mac marketed with its default Siri/Foundation-Models agent running fully on-device, matching the first-party-silicon-plus-default-local-agent shape
motivation: Apple already owns the silicon and the OS, so a bundled local agent is the natural way to defend its laptop tier against Nvidia's framing

task.who: Apple Silicon group plus the Foundation Models / on-device Siri team
task.what: Integrate on-device Foundation-Models agent as the default Mac assistant
task.where: M-series Mac platform, macOS, Apple Silicon Neural Engine
task.why: Defend the laptop tier with an owned silicon-plus-agent stack
task.how: On-device Foundation Models quantized to the Neural Engine envelope

job: Pairing a Google-designed Arm SoC (with Qualcomm or MediaTek) and an on-device Gemini/Gemma agent into a Windows or ChromeOS-on-Arm laptop
outcome: A shipping or beta first-party-silicon Windows/ChromeOS-on-Arm laptop bundling a default local Gemini-class agent, explicitly positioned against the N1/N1X framing
motivation: Google has the on-device model stack and an OS base and must not cede the agentic-PC tier to an Nvidia-Microsoft vertical bundle

task.who: Google Tensor/Pixel silicon team with Qualcomm or MediaTek and the Gemma on-device group
task.what: Co-design Arm SoC and bundle on-device Gemini agent by default
task.why: Avoid ceding the agentic-PC tier to a rival vertical bundle
task.how: Arm SoC partnership plus on-device Gemma/Gemini with QAT

job: Assembling a merchant-silicon vendor's answer - their own CPU plus an OEM and Microsoft - into a laptop with a bundled default local agent rather than an add-on
outcome: An announced shipping or beta laptop co-launched by AMD or Intel with an OEM and Microsoft, pairing first-party silicon with a default local agentic assistant
motivation: Merchant-silicon vendors saw their shares fall on the N1/N1X news and must prove the merchant model can still own the default-agent tier

task.who: AMD or Intel client-silicon team with an OEM and Microsoft Windows AI group
task.what: Co-launch a laptop bundling a default on-device agentic assistant
task.where: OEM laptop platform, Windows on-device AI stack, Microsoft co-marketing
task.why: Prove the merchant-silicon model can still own the agent tier
task.how: OEM plus Microsoft co-design and co-marketing partnership

job: Shipping the N1/N1X from Surface, Dell, HP, ASUS, Lenovo and MSI this fall and expanding the agentic-AI-PC category beyond a single SKU
outcome: A volume-shipping, multi-OEM agentic AI PC that hardens first-party-silicon-plus-default-local-agent into the category every platform owner feels it must match
motivation: Nvidia wants to own the AI stack underneath the laptop, turning a one-time CPU launch into the category rivals are forced to answer

task.who: Nvidia client-silicon group with Microsoft and six launch OEMs
task.what: Ship N1/N1X agentic PCs and widen OEM design wins
task.where: Surface, Dell, HP, ASUS, Lenovo and MSI launch laptops
task.why: Turn a single launch into a category rivals must match
task.how: Arm N1/N1X with integrated RTX/CUDA and a bundled local agent

job: Compressing capable multimodal models to fit an 8GB on-device envelope via quantization-aware training, so a bundled local agent is the default rather than cloud-routed
outcome: A Gemma-4-class multimodal model running locally within the agentic-PC memory envelope, making a default on-device agent technically viable for rivals to ship
motivation: A default local agent only counts if a capable model actually fits on-device; this efficiency work is the enabling condition for every rival SKU

task.who: On-device model and quantization research teams at model and silicon vendors
task.what: Quantize multimodal models to the 8GB on-device envelope
task.where: On-device inference runtime on agentic-PC NPUs and accelerators
task.why: Make a default local agent viable instead of cloud-routed
